records: CoinMarketCap's $1.25 XRP quote is a single-provider page snapshot retrieved at 2026-10-30T18:02:31Z; the provider's own observation timestamp and venue aggregation details are not exposed in the returned page. It is context-only and not a synchronized market feature.

Alpha Finance and SoSoValue-derived reporting show close October 29 daily ETF inflows (+USD8.4M and +USD8.4316M) but different cumulative inflows (USD1.73B versus USD1.809B). Fund universes, settlement completeness and cumulative definitions are not reconciled; do not average.
The Fed decision and Reuters weekly US fund flows are broad macro/allocation context. They do not establish XRP-specific subscriptions, redemptions, order flow or causal price impact.

TraderTraitor attribution is reported as an assessment by TRM Labs and Chainalysis, not a Binance-confirmed actor identity. Bitquery reports nine chains while TRM reports ten; cross-provider scope and totals differ.

The last cited attacker-receiver no-outgoing observation was captured at 2026-10-30T07:23:00Z. A fresh receiver read at the 18:02:31Z cutoff was not obtained because the explorer page could not be retrieved; no claim is made about intervening movement.
October 29 ETF flow data precede the first identified Binance XRPL transfer by five minutes (20:00 versus 20:05 UTC); those flows cannot be interpreted as a reaction to the incident.
Main's XRP signal remains stale and provider-degraded; the legacy 45.9% accuracy result is variable-horizon and mutable-outcome scoring. Neither is admitted as predictive performance.
Only the GitHub connector was authenticated and tested in this run. Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks remain untested; no live collaboration is claimed.

The archive_policy summary had stale duplicated counts while the authoritative archive pointers were current. The metadata was reconciled and validator coverage added; exact-head CI and fail-closed verification are pending.
